hmong: Kuv muaj ib co kua txob.
Niam yuav ib co nqaij.
Tej txhia tus menyuam nyiam mis.
Tej txhia lub tsev muaj aub.
Kuv muaj ob peb tus phooj ywg.
Niam yuav ob peb lub kua.
english: Mom will buy a few apples.
why: 'kua' is liquid/juice, not apple — the dictionary's apple is 'txiv es pauj'

hmong: Kuv muaj ntau tus phooj ywg.
Peb muaj ntau lub kua.
Hnub no coob tus neeg tuaj.
why: coob before the noun; the entry's own human example has it after ('Neeg coob')

hmong: Lub tsev kawm muaj coob tus menyuam.
why: school is 'tsev kawm ntawv'; and coob before the noun

hmong: Kuv muaj tsawg lub kua.
why: 'kua' is not apple; tsawg before the noun (human example: 'Neeg tsawg')

hmong: Niam muaj tsawg daim nyiaj.
why: tsawg before the noun (human example: 'Neeg tsawg')

hmong: Qee tus menyuam noj mov.
Qee lub tsev muaj aub.
Tej tus menyuam nyiam ua si.
Tej lub kua twb siav lawm.
Txhua hnub kuv mus kawm.
english: I go to school every day.

hmong: Txhua tus menyuam noj mov.
Txhua txhia tus menyuam tuaj.
Txhua txhia lub tsev muaj neeg.
Tag nrho cov menyuam noj mov.
Tag nrho lub tsev ntxuav lawm.
english: The whole house has been washed.
why: kept; English corrected from 'is clean now' — ntxuav is to wash
